channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Rain And Thunderstorms Likely Overnight
item.description: Rainfall potential will range between 1 to 2 inches.

item.title: Pedestrian struck, killed in Montgomery
item.description: Montgomery police are investigating a fatal accident involving a pedestrian.

item.title: What’s Happening: February 27-March 1
item.description: There are plenty of events happening in the River Region this weekend to bring out your inner nerd if you like learning new things!

item.title: 5-year-old girl killed in accidental shooting in Greenville
item.description: A five-year-old girl has been killed in an accidental shooting in Greenville.

item.title: Legislature considering allowing state to take over staffing at Montgomery Police Department
item.description: A bill that could put state officials in charge of police staffing in Montgomery is expected to reach the Alabama Senate floor next week.

item.title: Hillary Clinton testifies she has no information on Epstein’s crimes and doesn’t recall meeting him
item.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton told members of Congress that she had no knowledge of Jeffrey Epstein’s or Ghislaine Maxwell’s crimes, starting off two days of depositions that will also include former President Bill Clinton.

item.title: What The Tech: How Instagram is taking steps to protect your kids
item.description: Instagram’s latest move suggests platforms are responding by adding more built-in protections rather than relying solely on optional settings. Whether it’s enough remains a topic of debate.

item.title: Some sunshine Friday afternoon, pleasant and warm this weekend
item.description: Friday night looks a bit cooler, with lows in the upper 40s. Our weekend weather looks wonderful, with sunshine, no rain, and high temperatures in the mid 70s Saturday and Sunday.

item.title: Several Days Of Spring-Like Warmth Ahead
item.description: We could see temps climb into the lower 80s late next week.

item.title: Man to spend life behind bars for shooting at Montgomery gas station
item.description: A man recently found guilty for attempted murder and illegally possessing a gun in 2022 will now spend the rest of his life behind bars.
